messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: kv-cache-occupancy high (alert: cache_keys > 100M), continuous-batching latency spike, autoscale thrash detected in us-west-2. Pods flapping 3 -> 12 -> 4 in ~12m. 5xx rate increased from ~2% to ~8%. Potential customer impact on embedding/rerank endpoints. Paging eng-oncall.

Maya R.: ack. looking at grafana now -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/kv/kv-cache?orgId=1

Davi Chen: I can see the recent config rollout ~2234567800 that enabled `continuous_batching` on the batcher service and bumped `max_batch_size` to 64. cache prefix hot-paths started to amplify after that. suspect prefix amplification + large batches causing cache churn and warmup-induced CPU spikes.

Samir K.: if that's true the autoscaler is reacting to CPU spikes and then the batcher warmup causes another spike -> classic feedback loop. We should limit batch sizes immediately and add HPA stabilization window. Quick mitigations: 1) reduce `max_batch_size` to 16 2) set HPA `stabilizationWindowSeconds: 300` and `behavior` to add scaleDown stabilization 3) temporarily disable continuous batching on prod canary.

Davi Chen: on it. doing a canary patch to reduce batch size in us-west-2 canary pool.

Davi Chen: applying hotfix (canary) now:
```
kubectl -n inference patch configmap batcher-config -p '{"data":{"max_batch_size":"16"}}'
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/batcher-canary
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started for batcher-canary @us-west-2. CI checks: passed. Rolling 2/2 pods.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded for batcher-canary. New pods ready.

Maya R.: watching metrics — avg batch size down from ~52 -> ~14 in canary, cache_keys growth rate slowed. CPU spike amplitude reduced on canary.

Davi Chen: patching HPA to add stabilization (us-west-2 primary) — command:
```
kubectl -n inference patch hpa batcher-hpa -p '{"spec":{"behavior":{"scaleDown":{"stabilizationWindowSeconds":300}}}}'
```

Samir K.: also push a temporary change to HPA target to avoid overreacting: `targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 70` -> `80` for 10m.

Maya R.: ok i'm seeing pods stop thrashing; replicas settling 6 -> stable 6. 5xx back down to ~2.5%.

Davi Chen: will roll the `max_batch_size:16` to rest of regions after 5m of stable canary. preparing rollout script.

Maya R.: quick customer impact snapshot: ~12 customers saw elevated latencies (5-12s) for ~15-20 mins, ~3 enterprise accounts reported failed reranks (retries mitigated most). No data loss. severity: sev2 (degraded but service available).

Lina P.: taking handoff at 17:30 UTC. I'll own runbook and postmortem. summary for next shift:
- root cause: continuous_batching + high max_batch_size caused cache prefix amplification -> CPU spikes -> HPA thrash
- mitigation: reduced max_batch_size to 16, added HPA stabilization window, canary rollout then global rollout
- impact: increased latency and 5xx for ~20m, ~12 customers affected, one enterprise had degraded throughput
- follow-ups: schedule postmortem, add config guardrail to prevent >32 batch size in prod, add runbook step to disable continuous batching on rollback.

SRE Rotation: INC-2026-045 created: https://incidents.redwood.internal/INC-2026-045
Actions logged: hotfix applied, HPA patched, canary -> global rollout. Owner: Lina P.

Maya R.: notes for postmortem: collect batcher logs for 30m pre/post rollout, retain KV cache histograms, capture deployment timeline (who/when enabled continuous_batching ~2234567800). Also we should notify account team for the 3 affected enterprise customers.

Davi Chen: global rollout done. all regions now at `max_batch_size=16`. monitoring warming down.

deploy-bot: Global configmap rollout completed across regions.

Lina P.: taking over. I'll coordinate the blameless postmortem and customer comms. assigning owners for actions: postmortem draft - Maya R., config guardrail - Samir K., automated HPA hysteresis tests - Davi Chen. I'll ping customer success for outreach.

Maya R.: thanks team. small follow-up: add a regression test to deploy pipeline that fails if `continuous_batching=true` and `max_batch_size>32` in prod configs.

Samir K.: +1. will add to infra-automation backlog and try to get a PR out today.

SRE Rotation: handoff complete. leaving notes in incident ticket. :white_check_mark:

Lina P.: I'll update this thread with postmortem link when ready. good work on the quick mitigation. :+1:
